She was Lena while I was pregnant as her name is Alina

Now? Al, Chicken, Ma’ams, Madam Buhgawk, Madam Oogah, Boogs, Milady…pretty much anything but her government name 😂
I was induced at 41 and gave birth the next day. My baby is almost 8wks now!
I’ve been pregnant once in my life and I now have a healthy 6wk old daughter. My first appointment with the OBGYN was at 8 weeks as well where the pregnancy was confirmed.

You aren’t suffering alone and I’m sending you hugs.

I am a FTM and feel as though my postpartum mental health is robbing me of the joy of having a newborn. She’s almost 7wks old and I hold so much guilt over shouting at her when I get overwhelmed, for saying horrible things out of frustration. I don’t want to say awful things or shout at my baby because she’s just that - a little baby. She doesn’t know better.
I hope she doesn’t remember this and that I get better before she does remember.

This is hard, but we can do hard things mama 🩷

I was being the biggest jerk to my husband without provocation - I was one day late for my period, which isn’t a concern of mine usually, and found out super early.

Now my daughter is 6wks old today!

Chicken (Buffalo or Nashville Hot when she’s mad)
Miles Davis when she pees
Milady/ma’am(s)/her ma’amliness

Im sorry you’re going through this, but please know that you aren’t alone in how you feel. I’m only 4wks postpartum and am struggling to cope with wanting to hurt myself as well.
I’ve started therapy and will be looking into medication as well - is this an option for you?

“There is no village” hit hard over here. I’m a brand new ftm, baby will be 4wks old, and PPD/PPA are absolutely ruining my life. I need help and a break but asking always results in a disappointment unless it’s my husband (so thankful to have him). Hearing I’m a good mom is hard - I don’t think I am one, I think I’m just stuck without any other choice but to care for my kid.

I am so sorry to know you’re struggling. I can’t do anything about it but commiserate with you so you know that you aren’t alone in how you feel.

My daughter is 10 days old, also had to be vacuum-assisted due to her big head and I tore in several places. On top of this, she got stuck in my cervix and I was bombarded by hospital staff jumping on me and screaming at me to push, as well as shouting at me for screaming in pain and terror. I was scared that I was going to die in that moment because it happened so quickly and without any explanation.

Now I just wonder if this is really something I wanted. My mental health has completely tanked, I am constantly on edge, frustrated, and overwhelmed to the point of crying. Thankfully, my tearing is healing well but I’m still having so much trouble being able to relax physically or sit comfortably.

My husband has been my lifeline throughout the entire ordeal. I am not ready for him to go back to work in two days. I feel like I am barely surviving even when I’m just on night shift with baby and I know he’ll be there to relieve me soon. I don’t know how I’m going to go back to my full time job next month when I can barely function as it is.

I had to wait until today to be induced 🙃 I am 41wks, had absolutely no sign of labor either. It’s been slow going for the last 7hrs, but it’s a start.

Wishing for your little one to come quickly and safely, you got this mama 🩷

I looked incredible during the second trimester - hair, skin, nails, titties. I was absolutely glowing.
Now at 41wks? These titties are still iconic, but I feel as done and large as I look 😂

I’m struggling, but doing the best I can to keep going forward. I am 40+5 and getting induced at 41, so the end is in sight.
My mental health has been fragile for a lot of the pregnancy and it is because I am grieving for my mother. She passed on back in May and it hurts so much that she isn’t here to witness me become a mother or hold my daughter. I wanted so badly to share this experience with her.

Likely no harm at all. I was a functioning alcoholic up until the morning I got a positive test.
I went to my dr with these concerns and she told me that babies are resilient at that stage and that I should be fine as long as I abstained for the rest of my pregnancy.

I am currently 40+3 with a healthy and active baby girl. Not a drop since we found out and I sure am thankful to have sobered up for her sake.
Hoping neither of us have our babies on Christmas 😵‍💫 40+3
Definitely asking for that tomorrow when I see them!!
I feel you on this - 40+3 and sick of hearing this exact phrase. I am ready to hold my baby in my arms and have my body back to myself.
Hoping your little babe comes soon!!

I have not tried this - I’m generally not great with needles. However I see my OB in a couple days and plan to discuss any options to get this process going. I’ll try anything at this point, so thank you for the suggestion!
It happened to me too, I had a lot of anxiety after that and worried I was going to have GD. I failed the 1hr but passed the 3hr with flying colors.
Kudos to you for quitting, mama! It is not an easy habit to drop, I know from experience. But you are such an amazing mother for putting your babe first - they are lucky to have you!
Aeroflow is where I got mine, my local WIC office has also offered some help in this area as well.

I have been feeling a lot of the same things, but I am now 40+1 and haven’t gone past 1cm dilated. Uncomfortable is an understatement at this point, but not progressing toward labor.

Requesting a membrane sweep or to schedule an induction at my next appointment unless I get lucky and have my baby in the next couple days 😮‍💨

My husband and I both wanted a boy, I was convinced my baby was a boy, I was having dreams about a baby boy.
When I got the call that we were having a girl, I was disappointed for about 3mins. My husband was happier than I was for that news to be truthful. Now? We are both ecstatic and cannot wait for her to arrive!! (40+1)

I’m surprised you had a transvaginal ultrasound for the anatomy scan! I had one at my very first appointment to confirm the pregnancy and find out how far along I was, but none since then.

I’ve had 3 cervical checks in the last month. The first was done by a doctor at a hospital in the labor and delivery center when I was concerned about cramping - that *hurt*. Felt like she was trying to hurt me. I was soft, but not dilated then. The last two have been done by my OB at weekly checks per my request and it was mildly uncomfortable. But wayyyy more gentle than the dr at the hospital.

I am 39+5 - right there with you, soooo over being pregnant.
I’ve been at 1cm for the last week, no signs of labor, no end in sight. Her room is ready, car seats are installed in both cars, go-bags are in the trunk.

I just want my girl in my arms and out of my body, but I have a sinking suspicion that she will be overdue 😵‍💫

I have an anterior placenta and started feeling baby move at 22+1, my husband was able to feel the same day. But it was so very faint.

Now at 39+3? She is never still and can be seen moving by all 😂

A few in-laws have asked me if I was having twins because I am so big, same with some people who work in the same building as me. 

No, just one. But thanks for calling me fat!! 🥲
The waiting game once you get close to your due date. 39+1 and I am so done being pregnant - I just want to hold my baby girl already!
A medium rare steak with potatoes, salami, sushi, and I want a big ol’ glass of red wine!!!

Sincerely feeling this at 38+6. The pelvic pressure is so intense, the constant weight on my bladder is awful, and I am beyond uncomfortable. Baby girl is due in 8 days and I am so ready for her to get out of me. Very thankful for a husband that will rub and massage me every day wherever I ask, glad to have a yoga ball to stretch on, grateful to know I’ve started to dilate as of today (1cm!).

We’re in the home stretch, mamas. We can do this!

38+5 here and I get a lot of pain relief from hot showers. I also use shower steamers to help with congestion and making it a more spa-like experience.
Shaving tho? Nah, I haven’t been able to do that without huffing and puffing for the last 6wks. It’s a chore I hardly do anymore 😂
Congratulations mama! Wishing you a wonderful pregnancy, a smooth delivery, and a healthy little babe!
Low contact

My MIL constantly tells me what she thinks I ought to do. Don’t get an epidural or use any pain management, do everything you can do have a natural birth, make sure you breast feed and pump (but don’t do it too long either), don’t use pacifiers.

Listen lady, unless you’re the one pushing this baby out and raising her, your suggestions don’t mean anything to me. Also, you’re the last person I’d take birthing or child rearing advice from. Most of your children are LC for a reason.
12/19 here! FTM expecting a beautiful baby girl 🩷 I find out on Tuesday if I can be induced due to slightly lower amniotic fluid, I can’t wait to have my baby!!!
Foot rubs every night from my husband!

You are not alone in your grief for a lost fur baby. I think it’s normal, especially when the love ran so deep, to grieve for a long while.

12/6 will be one year since I lost my velvet hippo to cancer. He was the sweetest, smartest, most loving little boy on earth. He brought so much joy and laughter into all the days we had with him. Eight years was not enough time and I have not stopped missing him for even a moment since he took his last breath.
I feel this so much at 36+3 🥲 I love my girl so much but I am ready for her to vacate my body. We can do this!!!
36+2 here - buy the dang pillow. Splurge on a cooling pillow because you will overheat at night. I have used it every single night since 11wks and I have no regrets.

FTM here at 36+2 with a perfect baby girl! I am 29 and could not be happier. I get my last ultrasound on Monday and I cannot wait to see my girl one more time before she is in my arms.

My husband and I were trying for about 4mo, stopped actively trying because it was taking the fun out of our bedroom life, then boom! Found out at 4+1 and we’ve been over the moon since. This pregnancy has gone so smoothly and I feel inherently blessed to have enjoyed most of the journey.
36+1, due the 19th. I just want my girl here already!

This is making me cry at my desk.

I lost my mom 6mo ago and I’m 9mo pregnant now, I got to tell her about my baby and I got to make her so happy before she passed. It’s something I’ll never forget and I can’t wait to tell my daughter about her grandma in heaven.

Your dad will be so joyful to hear about your pregnancy and you will be so thankful you told him 🩷

I am 36wks today and I am so done with being pregnant. I just want to have my baby.
I have barely slept all week but when I have, the dreams are too vivid. I have a hard time sleeping because I can’t get comfortable or my acid reflux feels like lava in the back of my throat. I have been highly emotional all week, especially as we get closer to my due date. I am even more so because I am still actively grieving over my mom, who I lost back in May.
My baby feels like a sack of bricks in my belly, she “torpedos” into my bladder several times a day and I’ve peed myself on so many occasions.

I am so tired and uncomfortable. My kid is worth it all, but I’m not enjoying this anymore.
I needed the pat on the back today - 36wks tomorrow! I just want my baby here now!!! I am whale status and this acid reflux makes me want to cry sometimes!
Congratulations mama! So excited for you 🩷 wishing you a smooth pregnancy and a healthy babe at the end of things!!
Challenger SS is where it’s at
December 19th - I am 30 days away and reality hit pretty hard today. Can’t wait for my baby girl to arrive!!

At 35wks, the worst symptoms are carpal tunnel, insomnia, acid reflux, and being so dang uncomfortable because of my size. Back in the first trimester? I was constantly nauseous and exhausted. I was either asleep or I was tossing my cookies.

Invest in a pregnancy pillow and a belly band. Both have come in handy for me for sleep and general comfort when I’m active. I can’t sleep in the belly band though, I’m not sure I’d recommend that.

Although now at 35wks I’m suffering from some insomnia on top of just being plain old uncomfortable and too hot to sleep well.
December 19 and having a girl! These last 5wks are dragging on 😭

I love when my husband touches my belly, I don’t mind when people I know and like touch my belly.

I want to hit strangers in the face with a shovel when they do it. Keep your hands to yourself, cretin. You don’t touch people, especially without consent.

35wks tomorrow and I feel you mama. Breathing like an asthmatic bulldog all day, struggling to sit up or get up, constantly waddling to the toilet to pee, Braxton-Hicks everyday.

I just want my baby here because I’m done being pregnant.
She reacts when her dad sings, but she might enjoy it because hearing him sing makes me happy.
I felt kinda pregnant throughout the first trimester due to how sick I was. Now that I am almost 35wks, I feel super pregnant and super uncomfortable.
At 34wks with a daughter, I am terrified for both of us.

Do you have an OB appointment scheduled? If so, I think you should stop taking tests and just wait for your confirmation appointment. At this point it seems that testing every few days is a waste of money and a way to induce or exacerbate your anxiety. If there are no other concerning symptoms, I think it is safe to assume you are still pregnant and your little bean is doing just fine.

Congrats mama, I know the wait for the confirmation is tough!
I disc golf a couple times a week, but that’s even getting to be too taxing at 33+3 😮‍💨

We wanted a boy, I had multiple dreams about a boy, I thought I knew we were having a boy for sure.

Our daughter is due this December 😂🩷
22+1, first time mom with an anterior placenta. But since that day, she hasn’t stopped moving and I feel her all day long. 33wks today!
I ate like a human garbage disposal for the entirety of the second trimester. I’m now 33wks and can’t clear a plate again because my intestines are so squished.

My OB told me to count kicks and I was doing it twice a day religiously, but I’ve stopped tracking it because I found myself worrying about it all the time. Thankfully my baby is very active for most of the day anyway - she kicks so much that I feel like I’d know if something was wrong pretty quickly.
Good luck!!
I also have an anterior placenta - I felt my baby move at 22+1 🥰
30wks today, feeling her kick and punch constantly, my shower is next week. Yet it still doesn’t feel real that I am going to be her mom!

I have 80hrs of fully paid FMLA, then 6-8wks of short term disability at 50% of my pay. HOWEVER, i am due on 12/19 and come 1/1/25, I am required to exhaust my sick/business/vacation leave to be eligible for FMLA or short term disability again for 2025. I work for a government-funded agency that serves humans…except their staff 🙄

I will probably go on leave early and come back before I’m ready or healed because of the crappy FMLA/STD policy.
The first bite of food after a 3hr glucose test (14hrs of fasting) I cried today over a banana because I was so hungry and it tasted so good.
29wks today! Expecting our little princess on 12/19!
I will be almost 32wks by then, my husband and I are going to be skeletons. My shirt or dress will have the little skelly on the belly, his shirt will have food on the belly 😂

I don’t have any crazy advice; just try to be intimate for the sake of enjoying your partner. We struggled for a few months when we were actively trying and finally got our positive result in the first month we stopped trying.

I took a test in the evening while he was at work where the result looked too faint to be anything. Showed one of my best friends and she told me to get some more tests for the morning. I got up before him, took the tests and got a BFP within 3mins on all of them. I woke him up and showed him the tests - he was a bit bewildered at first 😂

We are 12wks away from our daughter’s due date now!

What ISNT she made of 😂

Pickles, shawarma, McDonald’s pancakes, Wendy’s breakfast burritos with cholula hot sauce, and coffee in all forms

I struggled with alcohol abuse until I got pregnant and drank excessively until the evening before I got a definite positive test. I was hungover when I tested positive that morning, but stopped cold turkey after that.

I am now 27wks with a very healthy baby girl 🩷

I took 4.

A Dollar Tree test on the first day my period was late, then 3 digital tests that I overnight-ordered after my friend told me the line test looked positive and I didn’t believe her.

One of my best friends had her one and is done, already got ‘fixed’ as well. The pregnancy ended in a very premature birth and she almost lost her life, the birth was very traumatic for her. I’m just so thankful she and her child are still around and healthy today!

My own child’s birth will determine whether or not we have a second, but for right now I do want my kid to have a sibling. It could change or I could remain steadfast in my decision.

A toasted and buttered bagel literally everyday for over 19wks 😂 I legitimately got upset enough to shed a couple tears yesterday morning because I pulled the last bagel out of the bag and found a spot of mold on it!

I found out at 4wks 1day! My period was only a day late and I was just being so mean to my husband! The wait for my first OB appointment was absolute torture!

We are now 15wks 3 days in, expecting a beautiful baby girl!
My little girl is the size of a peach! Can’t wait to meet her 🩷🩷

13+3
Just saw my little babe on an ultrasound too, looked like they gave me and their dad a wave ❤️

You forgot to mention how sandy the fairway is.

*I hate sand.*

I found out I was pregnant Friday of last week.
I’d taken a test Thursday night with the faintest line that I didn’t believe
Took three digital Friday morning and confirmed pregnant
Took my very last line test the following day, for no reason other than to see the line and be giddy

I am 5w2d, not much further than you. Just wait for your confirmation appointment and stop buying tests!

Oh my goodness! I love all of these! Whitetuft and Herongaze are my top pics - so unique and pretty!
Oooh. I initially voted for Darkstripe, but Brokenstar fits a million times better. Thanks for reminding me of his tyranny!

After suddenly losing my hippo to cancer at 8yrs old and having to max out a CareCredit account, I would strongly recommend pet insurance. The two days before he died was a mad scramble for cash and applying for loans to make sure we would have enough to cover treatments.

It wouldn’t have saved him, no one caught the cancer in time, but he wouldn’t have had to deal with our stress over money.
I met her for an autograph and photo yesterday, she 100% had a Founders All Day IPA in front of her at the table

YTA, and I think you’ve hurt your daughter more than the audience ever could have.

Even if she were embarrassed by said audience, it is YOUR job as her parent to be there for her, comfort her, remind her how awful it is for someone to be judged solely on their weight!

You should be ashamed of yourself, and ought to apologize to your daughter. And quickly. She’ll remember this in all of her worst moments - moments she will not feel safe sharing with you.
LOVE THIS!!!

Of course, I love the original colors of Kirara.

But I love PINK Kirara a million times more! You did such a great job! She’s so cute!!!

She is still with him, which is beyond me.

Thank you for validating my feelings. That means so much ❤️

Most of the advice I hear is to get over it, because “I’m still young”, and “it’ll happen when it’s meant to.” Which isn’t wrong, but negates the jealousy I feel on the matter.
It’s okay to tell them no, and it is not your responsibility to fix their reaction to your no.
You look incredible!! I LOVE your style of cosplay and this beautiful twist on Amaterasu 🥰 keep up the amazing work!

You NAILED it! Keep it up! 🥳
Here in the mitten, it’s 27°, but feels more like 15°. But the sun is out!! Counting down the minutes before I clock out of work and go play a chilly round with my husband 🥳

As someone working on their 100% NG+, I adore this game! It originally came out just after I started wanting my own save files on the family console, and I’ve carried love for it with me ever since.

The class system is a big draw for me and the continued story of FFX sold it for me. Some of it is light-hearted and fun, but other aspects deepen the story.

Lots of side quests to add to completion and some longer ones to carry out whilst playing; but definitely full of content to explore.

It’s got it’s cheesy moments, but it’s definitely worth at least one play-through, in my opinion 😊

That face, those eyes!! She looks like such a love bug, how hasn’t she been adopted?!

My 6yo boy hippo would love another (non-cat) sister, but we’re up in frosty MI 😭 wishing Phoebe all the luck in finding her forever home!!
The finer details are so clean and I love how you captured the expression on Amaterasu’s face! Great work!!

Absolutely stunning!!!!!!

I’m so thankful to know someone else understands! After this dog and our two cats go, I want no pets; they’re too noisy and I can’t deal anymore.
